Anatomy Department shines at MUHS State Level Research Conference
Thursday, 01 February 2018
4482 Hits
The faculty of MGIMS continue to be highly motivated in terms of their interest in research. This is evident from the fact that they frequently represent MGIMS on various regional, state level and national platforms to bring their research work into light.
Recently four faculty members of the institute participated in a  State Level Research Conference for Medical faculty (Category: Teacher Researcher) organized by Maharashtra University of Health Sciences, Nashik at Dr. V. M. Govt. Medical College, Solapur, on 21
st
January 2018.
At this celebrated platform, three faculty members of the Anatomy Department brought laurels to the institute. Mr. Pradeep Bokariya received First Prize for his Project presentation, Dr. Vijay Gujar stood Third and Dr. Bharat Sontakke was given consolation prize.
It is indeed a moment of pride for all MGIMSonians and the department deserves all the credit for the honor received!
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
